name: Purple United Sales Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2014, Purple United is a fashion brand that offers clothing, shoes, and accessories.[1]
keyPoints: Business Profile[1] The company's flagship footwear and clothing line, "Purple United Kids", accompanies children up to the age of 14 and offers laboratory-tested products. The company designs, develops, sources, markets, and distributes clothing and footwear for children between the age of 0-12 years. The company offers a wide range of accessories and hardware, such as strollers.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 26.5%
cons: Stock is trading at 7.50 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has high debtors of 214 days.
